The left Flare result has a dressed rabbit holding a flashlight beside a warm-lit cottage at dusk; the right comparator is FLUX.2 Klein 4B Distilled Edit. Only a truncated prompt is visible in the retained image; availability of a complete prompt elsewhere was not rechecked.
